answer: Proposal: a basalt ledger makes each coin exclusively lockable to one account; only squared locked balance buys shares of a fixed reef payout, never key count. Split S across k equal shale accounts and total weight falls to S²/k. The farm can share its model or borrow capital, but restoring S² needs S√k coins locked across those accounts for 40 epochs; lenders still charge for tied-up coins and fraud risk. Proposed validators reject duplicate locks, slash a key on a signed false attestation, and pay zero weight without a lock.
